operations.summary: Retrieves the status and results of an extract job. Use `jobId` to identify the job and check whether it is queued, active, completed, or failed. Completed results include extracted data and may include a generated JSON Schema when the request did not provide one.
operations.description: Get results for an extract job by job ID.

operations.summary: Retrieve organization details, plan information, and credit usage.
operations.description: Retrieve organization details, plan information, and credit usage.

operations.summary: Retrieves unified metadata for media hosted on supported internet platforms. Provide `url` as a URI for media such as YouTube videos, TikTok videos, Instagram posts, Twitter/X posts, or Facebook videos. The response includes platform and media identifiers, with available details about the author, media, and engagement.
operations.description: Fetch metadata from any supported internet media including YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X and Facebook posts. Returns unified metadata with a predictable structure across all platforms.

operations.summary: Retrieves a transcript for a video from a supported platform or a direct media file URL. Set `lang`, `text`, `chunkSize`, and `mode` to control the transcript language, format, chunking, and retrieval or generation behavior. For asynchronous processing, use GET /transcript/{jobId} with the returned job ID to check the result.
operations.description: Get transcript from a supported video platform (YouTube, TikTok, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook) or file URL. If the video is too large to return transcript immediately, request returns a job ID. Use the `/transcript/:jobId` endpoint to get job results.

operations.summary: Retrieves the status and results of a transcript job. Use `jobId` to identify the job and check whether it is queued, active, completed, or failed. Completed results may include transcript content, its language, and available language codes.
operations.description: Get results for a transcript job by job ID.

operations.summary: Retrieves the status and results of a website crawl job. Use `jobId` to identify the crawl and `skip` to request results starting at an offset. The response includes crawled pages when the job is completed and a `next` URL when more results are available.
operations.description: Get the status and results of a crawl by job ID.

operations.summary: Extracts links found across a website starting from a supplied URL. Provide `url` to identify the website to map. The response contains the discovered URLs.
operations.description: Extract all links found on a whole website.

operations.summary: Extracts webpage content as Markdown from a URL. Use `noLinks` to strip Markdown links and `lang` to request a preferred language using an ISO 639-1 code. The response also includes webpage metadata and URLs found on the page.
operations.description: Extract content from any web page to Markdown format.

operations.summary: Retrieves the status and results of a YouTube batch job identified by `jobId`. Use `limit` and `offset` to page through completed results in submission order, or omit both to receive all results in one streamed response.
operations.description: Get the status and results of a YouTube batch job.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many results (with `offset`, pages through a completed batch). Omit both to receive all results in one streamed response.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many results (in submission order) before returning a page.

operations.summary: Retrieves metadata for a YouTube channel identified by its URL, handle, or ID. Supply `id` in one of the supported YouTube URL formats or use the channel's handle or ID.
operations.description: Get metadata for a YouTube channel.

operations.summary: Lists video IDs from a YouTube channel identified by its URL, handle, or ID. Use `type` to select all videos, regular videos, Shorts, or live streams, and `limit` to set the maximum number returned.
operations.description: Get video IDs from a YouTube channel.

operations.summary: Retrieves metadata for a YouTube playlist identified by its URL or ID. Supply `id` in one of the supported YouTube URL formats or as a playlist ID.
operations.description: Get metadata for a YouTube playlist.

operations.summary: Lists video IDs from a YouTube playlist identified by its URL or ID. Set `limit` to control the maximum number returned; it defaults to 100 and must be between 1 and 5000.
operations.description: Get video IDs from a YouTube playlist.

operations.summary: Searches YouTube for videos, channels, and playlists. Use `query` with optional filters such as `type`, `uploadDate`, `duration`, `sortBy`, and `features` to refine results. Use `nextPageToken` to fetch another page; when you provide `limit`, the API paginates automatically.
operations.description: Search YouTube for videos, channels, and playlists with advanced filters.

operations.summary: Retrieves a transcript for a YouTube video, with options for language, chunk size, and plain-text output. Provide the video URL or ID and use `lang` to request a preferred ISO 639-1 language; if that language is unavailable, the first available language is used. This operation is closing down and will be removed on a date not specified.
operations.description: Get transcript from YouTube video in various formats and languages. If the `lang` parameter is not provided or the transcript is not available in the requested language, the API defaults to the first available language.

operations.summary: Translates a YouTube video transcript into the language specified by `lang`. Provide the video URL or ID, and optionally select plain-text output or set a chunk size for chunked output.
operations.description: Translate YouTube video transcript into different languages.

operations.summary: Retrieves metadata for a YouTube video identified by its URL or ID. Supply `id` in one of the supported YouTube URL formats or as a video ID. This operation is closing down and will be removed on a date not specified.
operations.description: Get metadata for a YouTube video.

operations.summary: Use AI to analyze video content and extract structured data. Provide either a prompt describing what to extract, a JSON Schema for the output format, or both. Supports YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and Facebook videos, or a direct media file URL. Returns a job ID for asynchronous processing. Use the `/extract/:jobId` endpoint to poll for results.
operations.description: Use AI to analyze video content and extract structured data. Provide either a prompt describing what to extract, a JSON Schema for the output format, or both. Supports YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and Facebook videos, or a direct media file URL. Returns a job ID for asynchronous processing. Use the `/extract/:jobId` endpoint to poll for results.

operations.summary: Submits a crawl job to extract content from pages on a website. Provide `url` as a URI and optionally set `limit` to cap the number of pages crawled; the default limit is 100. Use GET /web/crawl/{jobId} with the returned job ID to retrieve the crawl status and results.
operations.description: Create a crawl job to extract content from all pages on a website.

operations.summary: Creates an asynchronous batch job to retrieve transcripts for multiple YouTube videos. Supply `videoIds`, `playlistId`, or `channelId` to select the videos; playlist- and channel-based batches include regular videos only, skipping Shorts and live streams.
operations.description: Create a batch job to get transcripts of multiple YouTube videos. Batches created from a playlist or channel include regular videos only (Shorts and live streams are skipped).

operations.summary: Creates an asynchronous batch job to retrieve metadata for multiple YouTube videos. Supply `videoIds`, `playlistId`, or `channelId` to select the videos; playlist- and channel-based batches include regular videos only, skipping Shorts and live streams.
operations.description: Create a batch job to fetch metadata of multiple YouTube videos. Batches created from a playlist or channel include regular videos only (Shorts and live streams are skipped).
